expression (string): # stddev and variance: sample, exact decimals rounded to 12 places, nulls skipped
# skew and kurtosis: population g1 and excess g2, 12 places
# percentile: linear interpolation between the closest ranks, fraction 0 to 1
# percentileApprox: t-digest (compression 100), the agent's stored sketch
# countDistinct: exact, nulls skipped, equal numbers of any scale count once
# countDistinctApprox: HyperLogLog p12 over xxh64 of the canonical value, the agent's stored sketch
# distinct (alias unique): first-seen order, nulls skipped
# topK: the k most frequent values, ties by canonical value
# first and last: the first/last non-null item
# argMax and argMin over [value, key] pairs
output (json 5): ties go to the larger (argMax) or smaller (argMin) value
